chapters.rule: Start with namaste and the respectful आप. मेरा नाम works regardless of your gender. हूँ goes with मैं, हैं with आप.
phrases: How are you? (to a man or mixed group)
chapters.scenario: Meeting a neighbour for the first time.
chapters.q: Which pronoun is the safe respectful default for a stranger?
chapters.task: Introduce yourself in two sentences and ask the other person's name using आपका नाम क्या है?

chapters.rule: Hindi has eleven common independent vowels. Compare short and long sounds; quality also matters. अं and अः contain signs, not additional independent vowels. Listen before copying.
chapters.scenario: At a language exchange, ask your partner to repeat a sound.
chapters.q: Which letter is the long partner of इ?
chapters.task: Read the vowel chart aloud, then distinguish दिन and दीन with a Hindi-speaking partner.

chapters.rule: Consonants typically have an inherent vowel in isolation. Dental त and retroflex ट have different tongue positions; ख differs from क in aspiration. Use the chart to compare all 33 standard consonants.
chapters.scenario: Ask a partner to model two similar consonants.
dialogue: क और ख में क्या अंतर है?
ka aur kha mein kya antar hai
What is the difference between ka and kha?
ख में हवा ज़्यादा निकलती है।
kha mein hawa zyaada nikalti hai
More air comes out with kha.
chapters.q: Is त the same sound as ट?
chapters.a: No. त is dental; ट is retroflex.
chapters.task: Compare क/ख and त/ट. Hold your palm near your mouth to feel aspiration, then copy the chart.

chapters.rule: Dependent vowel signs attach to consonants. The sign ि is written to the left of its consonant but pronounced after it. Halant suppresses the inherent vowel; anusvara, chandrabindu and visarga are distinct signs.
chapters.scenario: Read a short sign with a partner.
chapters.q: Is the i vowel in कि pronounced before क?
chapters.a: No. It is pronounced after the consonant.
chapters.task: Use the vowel-sign builder, then write किताब, पानी, स्कूल and घर.

chapters.rule: Learn numbers as sound patterns, not only digit shapes. Hindi 11–99 has many irregular forms. कितना asks how much; कितने is used with masculine plural nouns.
chapters.q: What does चालीस mean?
chapters.task: Practise asking prices using 10, 20, 50 and 100 rupees.

chapters.rule: बजे is used for clock times. साढ़े means half past; सवा means a quarter past; पौने means a quarter to the stated hour. आज, कल and परसों require context.
dialogue: When will you come? (to a man)
Would half past three be okay?
chapters.q: What time is साढ़े तीन?
chapters.task: Say a suitable meeting time and confirm it with your partner.

chapters.rule: Use दीजिए, बताइए, बोलिए and कीजिए for respectful requests. मुझे समझ नहीं आया is useful when you cannot follow a conversation.
chapters.q: Which expression asks someone to repeat?
chapters.task: Roleplay not understanding a price, and ask for clarification twice politely.

chapters.rule: Combine greeting, personal information, numbers, needs and repair phrases. Say only what you can understand; asking for repetition is a communication skill.
dialogue: क्या आप हिंदी सीख रही हैं?
kya aap Hindi seekh rahee hain
Are you learning Hindi? (to a woman)
हाँ, मैं अभी सीख रही हूँ।
haan, main abhee seekh rahee hoon
chapters.q: Which form would a female speaker normally use: रहा or रही?
chapters.task: Give a one-minute introduction, ask a question, and read five simple signs without help.

assessment.title: पहली मुलाकात
text: मीरा आज जयपुर में हैं। वह हिंदी सीख रही हैं।
Meera is in Jaipur today. She is learning Hindi.
वह एक दुकान में जाती हैं। उन्हें दो बोतल पानी चाहिए।
She goes into a shop. She needs two bottles of water.
दुकानदार कहता है, एक बोतल बीस रुपये की है। मीरा कहती हैं, धीरे बोलिए।
The shopkeeper says one bottle costs twenty rupees. Meera says, please speak slowly.
questions: What does she ask the shopkeeper to do?
assessment.task: Introduce yourself, ask a price, understand the answer and request repetition. Read the vowel and consonant charts and write five words.

stages.entry: Know the script basics, numbers and common requests or use the Foundation stage.

chapters.rule: Possessive मेरा/मेरी/मेरे agrees with the possessed noun, not the speaker. का/की/के follows the same pattern.
phrases: Where do you live? (to a man)
chapters.scenario: A neighbour asks about your home.
dialogue: क्या आपका परिवार भी यहाँ है?
kya aapka parivaar bhee yahaan hai
हाँ, मेरी बहन यहाँ रहती है।
haan, meree bahan yahaan rahtee hai
chapters.q: Why मेरी बहन rather than मेरा बहन?
chapters.task: Describe a fictional family with three possessive phrases.

chapters.rule: Use मुझे … चाहिए to request something. कम and बिना specify preferences. If you have an allergy, communicate it explicitly and confirm with staff; language practice is not medical assurance.
dialogue: Please give me lentils and flatbread.
chapters.q: How do you request less chilli?
chapters.task: Order two dishes, request a change and ask for the bill.

chapters.rule: ये/वे can refer to plural nouns. कितना/कितनी and adjective forms depend on noun gender. Asking about the price is not the same as accepting it.
chapters.q: What word means receipt?
chapters.task: Ask price, colour and payment method for a fictional item.

chapters.rule: में indicates location inside, पर at/on, तक as far as. के पास means near; के सामने means opposite/in front of.
dialogue: Excuse me, where is the station?
Yes, it will take five minutes.
chapters.q: What direction does दाएँ mean?
chapters.task: Draw a simple fictional route and give three instructions to reach a station.

chapters.rule: Use मुझे … चाहिए for a room or ticket. क्या … है? asks availability. Bookings should be confirmed in writing when possible.
phrases: Where can I get a ticket?
dialogue: यह आपके कमरे की चाबी है।
yah aapke kamre kee chaabee hai
chapters.q: What does किस नाम से ask?
chapters.task: Roleplay checking in, asking for Wi-Fi and confirming checkout time.

chapters.rule: Use मुझे … है or मेरे … में दर्द है to describe symptoms. Use कब से to explain duration. This lesson teaches communication, not diagnosis or treatment.
chapters.scenario: At a clinic, describing a fictional symptom.
chapters.q: How do you say you need help?
chapters.task: Practise a fictional clinic conversation: symptom, duration, and a request to repeat instructions. Do not self-diagnose.

chapters.rule: Habitual ता/ती/ते agrees with the subject; हूँ/है/हैं reflects person and number. अभी with रहा/रही/रहे describes ongoing action.
phrases: I get up in the morning (male speaker).
dialogue: What do you do in the morning?
I go for a walk (male speaker).
chapters.q: Which phrase describes action happening now?
chapters.task: Describe your routine with four actions, then say what you are doing right now.

chapters.rule: In short messages, include the reason, time and expected response. Respectful imperatives remain useful over the phone.
phrases: क्या मैं बाद में फ़ोन करूँ?
kya main baad mein phone karoon
I will arrive at five (male speaker).
dialogue: नमस्ते, क्या अभी बात कर सकते हैं?
namaste, kya abhee baat kar sakte hain
I am a little busy now.
chapters.q: How do you say the audio is unclear?
chapters.task: Write a short message to reschedule an appointment politely.

assessment.title: एक दिन की यात्रा
text: सारा को रविवार को दिल्ली जाना है। उनके पास सुबह नौ बजे की ट्रेन का टिकट है।
Sara needs to go to Delhi on Sunday. She has a ticket for the nine o'clock train.
वह स्टेशन के सामने की दुकान से पानी लेती हैं। फिर वह पूछती हैं कि ट्रेन किस प्लेटफ़ॉर्म से जाएगी।
She buys water from the shop opposite the station, then asks which platform the train will leave from.
शाम को वह अपनी बहन को संदेश भेजती हैं कि वह सुरक्षित पहुँच गई हैं।
In the evening she messages her sister that she has arrived safely.
questions: रविवार सुबह नौ बजे। Sunday at nine.
स्टेशन के सामने की दुकान से। From the shop opposite the station.
assessment.task: Simulate checking a ticket, requesting directions, ordering food and sending an arrival message. Use respectful requests and gender agreement.

stages.entry: Handle everyday exchanges and read simple Hindi sentences.

chapters.rule: With many transitive perfective verbs, ने marks the agent and the verb agrees with an unmarked object. Intransitive गया/गई agrees with the subject. Compare मैंने किताब पढ़ी and मैं घर गया.
chapters.q: Why पढ़ी in मैंने किताब पढ़ी?
chapters.a: It agrees with the unmarked feminine object किताब.
chapters.task: Tell a partner about three things you did yesterday; include one intransitive and one transitive verb.

chapters.rule: Future endings change by person, gender and number: जाऊँगा/जाऊँगी, जाएँगे/जाएँगी. चाहना expresses intention or desire; the future may also express prediction.
dialogue: What will you do on Sunday?
We will go to the park.
At what time shall we meet?
We will meet at nine in the morning.
chapters.q: Which future form suits मैं for a woman?
chapters.task: Plan an imaginary weekend, propose two times and agree on one.

chapters.rule: मुझे लगता है कि introduces an opinion, not a verified fact. खुश/उदास can describe states. Agree or disagree without attacking the person.
dialogue: How did you find the event?
मुझे अच्छा लगा, लेकिन आवाज़ तेज़ थी।
mujhe achchha laga, lekin aawaaz tez thee
I liked it, but the sound was loud.
Next time we will offer a suggestion.
chapters.q: Does मुझे लगता है कि mark certainty?
chapters.a: No, it introduces the speaker's view or impression.
chapters.task: Express a preference, explain why and politely acknowledge a different opinion.

chapters.rule: से marks the comparison standard in X, Y से बड़ा है. सबसे introduces a superlative within a stated group. ज़्यादा and कम also modify degrees.
dialogue: Is the bus cheaper or the taxi?
The bus is cheaper than a taxi.
But the taxi will arrive sooner.
आज समय कम है, टैक्सी लेते हैं।
aaj samay kam hai, taxi lete hain
We have little time today, let's take a taxi.
chapters.q: Which word marks the comparison in बस टैक्सी से सस्ती है?
chapters.task: Compare two fictional hotels on price, location and accessibility; explain your choice.

chapters.rule: सकना expresses ability or possibility, चाहिए advice or need. अगर … तो introduces a condition. A useful complaint states the issue and the desired remedy.
dialogue: There is a problem with this item.
हाँ, क्या इसे बदल सकते हैं?
haan, kya ise badal sakte hain
chapters.q: Which word introduces a condition?
chapters.task: Describe a fictional service problem, request a remedy, and suggest a backup option.

chapters.rule: Use आप with colleagues unless a different convention is agreed. Confirm ownership and deadlines explicitly. Passive language can conceal who must act.
phrases: I will send the report (male speaker).
dialogue: How far along is the report?
When will the rest be done?
I will send it by Friday (female speaker).
chapters.q: What does तक mean in शुक्रवार तक?
chapters.task: Give a fictional project status with finished work, pending work and one deadline.

chapters.rule: Invitations vary by relationship and setting. जी adds respect in many contexts, not a universal requirement. Politely declining need not include private details.
phrases: I won't be able to come this time (male).
dialogue: Please come to our home on Saturday.
Thank you very much, at what time?
chapters.q: How do you decline without sounding abrupt?
chapters.a: धन्यवाद, इस बार नहीं आ पाऊँगा/पाऊँगी।
chapters.task: Accept one fictional invitation and decline another respectfully.

chapters.rule: Read for purpose, date, place and required action before translating every word. In listening, use context and ask about only the missing detail.
chapters.scenario: Reading a notice about a library event.
dialogue: The event will take place Friday.
chapters.q: Which detail confirms cost?
chapters.task: Summarize a fictional notice: event, date, time, place and any missing details.

assessment.title: पुस्तकालय की बैठक
text: कल पुस्तकालय की बैठक हुई। कई लोगों ने शाम के समय पुस्तकालय खुला रखने का सुझाव दिया।
The library held a meeting yesterday. Several people suggested keeping it open in the evening.
कुछ कर्मचारियों को देर तक काम करने की चिंता थी। इसलिए समिति ने पहले दो दिन का परीक्षण करने का प्रस्ताव रखा।
Some staff were concerned about working late. The committee therefore proposed trying two days first.
अगले महीने परिणाम देखकर निर्णय लिया जाएगा। अभी स्थायी बदलाव की पुष्टि नहीं हुई है।
A decision will be made after reviewing the results next month. A permanent change has not yet been confirmed.
questions: शाम को पुस्तकालय खुला रखना। Evening opening.
कर्मचारियों के देर तक काम करने की चिंता। Staff working late.
Has a permanent change been confirmed?
assessment.task: Explain a past event, compare two options, propose a conditional solution and summarize a partner's opinion without changing its meaning.

stages.entry: Describe experiences and plans, understand a short passage and give reasons.

chapters.rule: Hindi register includes pronouns, verb endings, vocabulary and context. आप is not automatically formal in every family; choose forms according to relationship and preferences.
dialogue: क्या आप मुझे समय बता सकते हैं?
kya aap mujhe samay bata sakte hain
Could you tell me the time?
When will you come? (familiar, to a man)
chapters.q: Which imperative fits आप: बैठो or बैठिए?
chapters.task: Rewrite a casual message as a respectful office request, preserving meaning.

chapters.rule: जो … वह links a relative clause with a main clause. क्योंकि explains a reason, जबकि contrasts, हालांकि concedes. The connectors must match the relation.
dialogue: हालांकि समय कम है, हम शुरू कर सकते हैं।
haalaanki samay kam hai, ham shuroo kar sakte hain
Although time is short, we can start.
ठीक है, पहले ज़रूरी विषय लें।
theek hai, pahle zarooree vishay lein
Okay, let's take the essential topic first.
chapters.q: Which connector expresses concession?
chapters.task: Join three pairs of short sentences with cause, contrast and relative clauses.

chapters.rule: अगर … तो expresses a condition. शायद marks uncertainty. Counterfactual होता/होती can describe an unreal or hypothetical state; distinguish from a confirmed event.
phrases: Perhaps there will be a delay.
dialogue: अगर बारिश हुई तो क्या करेंगे?
agar baarish huee to kya karenge
What will we do if it rains?
We can go to the museum.
chapters.q: Does शायद express certainty?
chapters.task: Make a plan with two contingencies and one explicitly uncertain prediction.

chapters.rule: Vector verbs such as देना, लेना and जाना can add completion, direction, benefit or change of state. The nuance depends on context; do not translate every compound literally.
dialogue: Yes, we can send it now.
chapters.q: What does लिया contribute in पढ़ लिया?
chapters.a: It commonly indicates completed reading, often for oneself.
chapters.task: Contrast पढ़ रहा हूँ, पढ़ा and पढ़ लिया in a fictional situation.

chapters.rule: Separate what a report states, what a witness claims, and what has been independently confirmed. के अनुसार attributes information. कथित or बताया गया can mark an unverified claim.
chapters.scenario: Discussing a fictional local bus proposal.
dialogue: नई बस सेवा का प्रस्ताव है।
naee bas seva ka prastaav hai
There is a proposal for a new bus service.
It has not yet been confirmed.
chapters.q: Is a प्रस्ताव the same as an approved decision?
chapters.task: Summarize a fictional news story, label confirmed facts and unresolved claims.

chapters.rule: A constructive argument contains a claim, reason and relevant evidence. Acknowledge uncertainty and the strongest opposing point. Avoid attacking people.
phrases: What is the basis for this?
dialogue: मेरे विचार से शाम को खुलना चाहिए।
mere vichaar se shaam ko khulna chaahiye
In my view it should open in the evening.
लेकिन कर्मचारियों का समय भी देखना होगा।
lekin karmachaariyon ka samay bhee dekhna hoga
But staff schedules also need consideration.
क्या सप्ताह में दो दिन बढ़ा सकते हैं?
kya saptaah mein do din badha sakte hain
Could we extend hours on two days a week?
chapters.q: What should support a claim?
chapters.task: Argue for a fictional public service, then summarize the opposing position fairly.

chapters.rule: Use a concise subject, purpose, relevant dates, requested action and polite closing. Official terminology should be clear rather than unnecessarily ornate.
chapters.scenario: Requesting a fictional document by email.
dialogue: हाँ, विषय में प्रमाणपत्र का उल्लेख है।
haan, vishay mein pramaanpatr ka ullekh hai
Yes, the subject mentions the certificate.
Have you requested confirmation of receipt?
Yes, at the end of the letter.
chapters.q: What should a subject line do?
chapters.task: Draft a formal email asking for a fictional document and confirming the deadline.

chapters.rule: Use chronology, sensory detail and a meaningful turning point. First-person narration reflects a viewpoint, not necessarily the entire truth. Past tenses organize events and background.
dialogue: At first I couldn't find the way.
एक व्यक्ति ने मदद की और हम पहुँच गए।
ek vyakti ne madad kee aur ham pahunch gaye
chapters.q: Which word marks an unexpected event?
chapters.task: Tell a fictional 150-word travel story with a beginning, turning point and ending.

assessment.title: समुदाय की सूचना
text: नगर के एक काल्पनिक समुदाय केंद्र ने शाम की भाषा कक्षा का प्रस्ताव रखा। प्रारंभिक सर्वेक्षण में कुछ लोगों ने रुचि दिखाई, लेकिन समय और स्थान पर मत अलग थे।
A fictional community centre proposed an evening language class. Some respondents expressed interest, but preferences about time and place differed.
समिति ने तय किया कि यदि पर्याप्त लोग तैयार हों, तो पहले चार सप्ताह का परीक्षण होगा। हालांकि संसाधन सीमित हैं, केंद्र एक कमरा उपलब्ध करा सकता है।
The committee decided that, if enough people were willing, a four-week trial would be held. Although resources are limited, the centre can provide a room.
अंतिम निर्णय अभी लंबित है। इच्छुक लोगों से अपनी उपलब्धता लिखित रूप में भेजने का अनुरोध किया गया है।
The final decision is pending. Interested people are asked to send their availability in writing.
questions: What condition must be met for the trial?
पर्याप्त लोग तैयार हों। Enough people must be willing.
What resource can the centre provide?
assessment.task: Write a formal response, then give a short argument for and against the proposed class. Separate facts, conditions and opinions.

stages.entry: Understand extended passages, organize arguments and write connected Hindi.

chapters.rule: A summary compresses main ideas without adding unsupported facts. A paraphrase preserves meaning in different wording. Attribute another writer's distinctive ideas even when paraphrased.
dialogue: लेख का मुख्य विचार क्या है?
lekh ka mukhya vichaar kya hai
What is the article's main idea?
पुस्तकालय सबके लिए सुलभ होना चाहिए।
pustakaalay sabke liye sulabh hona chaahiye
Libraries should be accessible to everyone.
क्या लेखक ने उदाहरण दिया है?
kya lekhak ne udaaharan diya hai
Did the author give an example?
हाँ, बड़े अक्षरों वाली किताबों का।
haan, bade aksharon vaalee kitaabon ka
chapters.q: Should a summary invent new evidence?
chapters.task: Summarize the dialogue in two Hindi sentences and distinguish the argument from its example.

chapters.rule: A strong spoken answer states a situation, action and result. In a presentation, introduce the purpose, organize points and conclude with the requested action. Do not invent qualifications.
dialogue: Give an example of a challenge.
हमने काम बाँटा और समय पर पूरा किया।
hamne kaam baanta aur samay par poora kiya
We divided the work and finished on time.
chapters.q: What makes the answer concrete?
chapters.a: A situation, an action and a result.
chapters.task: Give a two-minute presentation on an imaginary project, then answer two follow-up questions.

chapters.rule: Translation preserves intention and context rather than word order. Respect level, idiom and ambiguous terms may need clarification. Keep names, amounts and deadlines accurate.
dialogue: क्या कल का अर्थ हमेशा tomorrow है?
kya kal ka arth hamesha tomorrow hai
नहीं, बीता या आने वाला दिन हो सकता है।
nahin, beeta ya aane vaala din ho sakta hai
No, it can be yesterday or tomorrow.
Right, writing the date would be better.
chapters.q: Why confirm कल in an appointment?
chapters.task: Translate a fictional reminder both ways and note two choices about politeness and ambiguity.

chapters.rule: Read for narrator, imagery and context. A text's cultural reference is not evidence that every Hindi speaker shares the same practice. Support interpretation with words from the text.
dialogue: कवि ने खिड़की का उल्लेख क्यों किया?
kavi ne khidkee ka ullekh kyon kiya
Why did the poet mention the window?
शायद नई संभावना दिखाने के लिए।
shaayad naee sambhaavana dikhaane ke liye
Perhaps to suggest a new possibility.
कौन-सा शब्द इसका संकेत देता है?
kaun-sa shabd iska sanket deta hai
The word open in open window.
chapters.q: Is the interpretation the only possible one?
chapters.a: No, support plausible interpretations with textual evidence.
chapters.task: Write four original lines about a window or journey and explain one image in Hindi.

chapters.rule: Distinguish direct evidence, reported information and inference. Check author, date, purpose and sample. A small observation cannot justify a universal claim.
dialogue: क्या पूरे शहर के बारे में कह सकते हैं?
kya poore shahar ke baare mein kah sakte hain
Can we generalize to the whole city?
नहीं, नमूने की सीमा बतानी होगी।
nahin, namoone kee seema bataanee hogee
No, we need to state the sample limitation.
chapters.q: Why mention the sample size?
chapters.a: It limits what conclusions are supported.
chapters.task: Write a short evidence note distinguishing observation, inference and an unanswered question.

chapters.rule: Separate a proposal from agreement; confirm scope, cost and time in writing. Conditional phrases can make tradeoffs explicit. This is language practice, not legal advice.
phrases: इस बिंदु पर सहमति नहीं है।
is bindu par sahamati nahin hai
There is no agreement on this point.
dialogue: क्या काम सोमवार तक हो सकता है?
kya kaam somvaar tak ho sakta hai
Can the work be done by Monday?
अगर सामग्री आज मिले तो संभव है।
agar saamagree aaj mile to sambhav hai
It is possible if the materials arrive today.
समय और काम की सीमा लिख दें।
samay aur kaam kee seema likh dein
Let's write down the timing and scope.
ठीक है, पहले लिखित पुष्टि करेंगे।
theek hai, pahle likhit pushti karenge
Okay, we'll confirm in writing first.
chapters.q: What should be clarified before declaring agreement?
chapters.a: Scope, conditions, deadlines and actual acceptance.
chapters.task: Roleplay a fictional negotiation and write a short summary of agreed and pending points.

chapters.rule: Edit in passes: factual accuracy, organization, clarity, then spelling and punctuation. Preserve the intended message and voice. Prefer precise verbs and concrete dates over vague expressions.
dialogue: Yes, that will make the timing clear.
chapters.q: Which change improves clarity in जल्द आएँ?
chapters.a: Specify the date or time if known.
chapters.task: Edit a 100-word fictional message; explain three changes to meaning or clarity.

chapters.rule: Use Hindi to accomplish a genuine task: understand a source, ask questions, explain evidence, write a response and revise. Ask a fluent speaker for feedback. This is a self-assessment, not a certified proficiency test.
dialogue: अब मैं सूचना पढ़कर सार लिख सकता हूँ।
ab main soochna padhkar saar likh sakta hoon
Now I can read a notice and write a summary (male speaker).
बिना तैयारी के बातचीत का अभ्यास।
bina taiyaaree ke baatcheet ka abhyaas
chapters.q: Does self-marked completion prove fluency?
chapters.a: No. It records practice; independent evaluation is needed.
chapters.task: Prepare a 250–400 word Hindi report on a fictional or non-sensitive topic, give a three-minute talk and request feedback on accuracy, clarity and comprehension.

assessment.title: एक छोटा शोध और प्रस्तुति
text: एक काल्पनिक अध्ययन में बीस लोगों से पूछा गया कि वे हिंदी सीखने के लिए किस तरह की सामग्री पसंद करते हैं। बारह ने संवाद, पाँच ने पठन और तीन ने लेखन चुना।
In a fictional study, twenty people were asked which Hindi learning material they preferred. Twelve chose dialogue, five reading and three writing.
इन परिणामों से केवल इस छोटे समूह की पसंद का संकेत मिलता है। प्रश्नों की भाषा और उत्तरदाताओं के चयन से परिणाम प्रभावित हो सकते हैं। इसलिए पूरे शहर पर निष्कर्ष लागू करना उचित नहीं होगा।
These results only indicate the preferences of this small group. The question wording and respondent selection may affect the results, so generalizing to the whole city would not be appropriate.
अगले चरण में अलग पृष्ठभूमि वाले लोगों से पूछना और उनके उत्तरों की तुलना करना उपयोगी होगा।
A useful next step would be to ask people from different backgrounds and compare their responses.
questions: नमूना छोटा और सीमित है। The sample is small and limited.
What is the proposed next step?
अलग पृष्ठभूमि वाले लोगों से पूछकर उत्तरों की तुलना करना। Ask different groups and compare responses.
assessment.task: Prepare a 250–400 word report, a three-minute spoken summary, a careful source note and a revised final draft. Seek a fluent speaker's feedback. No certificate or automatic fluency claim.
